notes: SECRET-FREE configuration file. Never put a password, password hash, API key or token in this file or anywhere else in this repository.
Leave "endpoint" empty to keep the Admin Login screen in its 'authentication not configured' state (it will refuse to verify anything and will never fake a successful login).
To enable real sign-in, deploy a server-side authentication endpoint and set "endpoint" to its URL (https:// only, or a same-origin path such as "/api/admin/login").

Contract: POST JSON { username, password } with credentials included. Respond 200 with { "authenticated": true } on success, 401 with { "authenticated": false } on invalid credentials. The server must hash the stored password (Argon2id, scrypt or bcrypt) and set an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite session cookie on success.
